subject: sounds
title: Short vowel sounds
about: Hear a three-sound word and pick the vowel letter that makes its middle sound. The five short vowels (a as in hat, e bed, i pig, o hot, u sun) are the first spellings CKLA Unit 1 reviews.
tip: Stretch the middle of the word (haaat) and ask what sound he hears.

cards.q: Which letter makes the middle sound in hat?
cards.note: The middle sound in hat is short a. Hat is our key word for short a.

cards.q: Which letter makes the middle sound in bag?
cards.note: The middle sound in bag is short a, like in hat.

cards.q: Which letter makes the middle sound in jam?
cards.note: The middle sound in jam is short a, like in hat.

cards.q: Which letter makes the middle sound in bed?

cards.q: Which letter makes the middle sound in jet?
cards.note: The middle sound in jet is short e, like in bed.

cards.q: Which letter makes the middle sound in web?
cards.note: The middle sound in web is short e, like in bed.
